topic.title: Gold exchange before Dhanteras
topic.claim: After May's duty hike, old gold became a big part of jewellers' supply, and the exchange bonus is what it costs them to turn your locker into a sale.
topic.moment: The jeweller weighing mummy's old bangles before Dhanteras and offering an exchange bonus.

turn.believed: the exchange bonus is the jeweller doing you a favour
turn.actually: since imports fell after the duty hike, old gold is a main supply line, and exchange guarantees a sale

topic.because: exchange gold needs no import or upfront duty and only comes with a new purchase, with making charges and GST on it
topic.payoff: If the exchange route isn't clearly cheaper than the cash route, it was never a bonus.

proof.fact: Customs duty on gold rose from 6% to 15% (BCD 5 to 10, AIDC 1 to 5) from 13 May 2026; gold imports fell about 70% after the hike
GTRI: effective duty on gold including IGST rose to 18.45% from 9.18%
46% of Kalyan Jewellers' revenue in Q1 FY27 was from recycled gold; nearly 65% of jewellery sales at Joy Alukkas are from old gold exchanges

paragraphs: This Dhanteras, the jeweller will offer an "exchange bonus" on mummy's old bangles. It isn't generosity. Since May, her bangles are his supply line.
slides.why_swipe: 'supply line' contradicts the favour everyone assumes; what changed in May?

paragraphs: Glass counter. Small scale. The bangles from her wedding, still in the red pouch.
He tests them, weighs them, cuts a little for melting, then smiles. "Aunty, exchange bonus bhi denge."
Everyone walks out feeling they won. I used to think so too.
slides.why_swipe: the reader has lived this scene; the narrator found something out

paragraphs: Here's what changed. In May, the duty on imported gold went from 6% to 15%.
**After the hike, imports fell about 70%.** The wedding season didn't.
slides.why_swipe: imports collapsed; the gap is filled from somewhere

paragraphs: So more of the gold now comes from your family locker.
Kalyan says recycled gold was almost half its revenue in April to June.
slides.why_swipe: the scale is proven; what does the jeweller get beyond the gold?

paragraphs: Exchange offers aren't new. What changed in May is how much he needs your gold.
At most big chains, an exchange only works against a new purchase. The bonus is a sweetener he earns back on the new piece, in full making charges.
slides.why_swipe: the seller's side is out; how do you tell if your bonus is real?

paragraphs: So before you say yes, get two numbers in writing.
One: the new piece with the exchange, after the bonus. Two: the new piece without exchange, minus what he'd pay in cash for the same bangles.
**If one isn't clearly lower, it was never a bonus. It was the price of mummy's gold.**

draft.caption: Has anyone in your family ever asked for the cash price of their old gold before taking the exchange bonus?
draft.alt_text: A text carousel arguing that after the May 2026 gold duty hike, old gold exchange became a main supply for jewellers, with a test for whether an exchange bonus is real.

cover.headline: Mummy's old gold is now the jeweller's [supply line.]
cover.sub: This Dhanteras, the exchange bonus isn't generosity.

end.save: Take the two numbers to the jeweller's counter on 6 Nov.
end.send: Know someone exchanging old gold this Dhanteras? Send it to them.

Before the duty hike, total tax on impor.correct: 9.18% was the effective rate up to 12 May 2026, immediately before the hike took effect on 13 May 2026.

sources.publisher: The Tribune (citing a senior Finance Ministry official)
sources.quote: India's imports of gold have decreased by almost 70 per cent to 25–30 tonnes after the customs levy on the yellow metal was more than doubled to 15 per cent
Gold imports have been reduced to 25-30 tonnes after an import duty hike in a month, from 75-100 tonnes earlier

Kalyan Jewellers got 46% of its revenue.correct: Figure refers to Q1 FY27 (April–June 2026); Kalyan Jewellers' own Q1 FY27 results were announced 4 Aug 2026, and the share rose further within the quarter (over 55% in June alone).

sources.publisher: Kalyan Jewellers Q1 FY27 earnings call transcript (company statement, via AlphaStreet)
sources.quote: The initiative was well received by our customers, helping us to increase the share of recycled gold as a percentage of revenue to over 46% during Q1 FY '27.
46 per cent of Kalyan Jewellers' revenue in the first quarter of FY27 was from recycled gold.

At most big jewellery chains, an exchang.correct: Standard 'exchange' programmes at major chains (Tanishq, Joyalukkas, CaratLane) are store credit only; separate 'buyback' programmes at some retailers (e.g., Candere) do pay cash via bank transfer, so exceptions exist outside the core exchange offer.

sources.quote: You cannot exchange your old gold for cash or gold coins... The value of your old gold is credited towards your purchase, and you only pay the difference.

sources.publisher: Tanishq (company's own Gold Exchange Programme page)
sources.quote: No cash refund will be provided for exchange at Tanishq... GEP is an exchange program providing store credit against eligible purchases and is not a gold buyback, resale, or cash purchase program.

Jewellers recoup the exchange bonus by c.correct: The precise mechanism: making charges paid on the old piece are never refunded, and the new piece carries its own (often undiscounted) making charges, which is how retailers offset the exchange value given — not literally 'full making charges' as a stated policy line on any single jeweller's page.

sources.quote: Making charges from the original bill never return, because they paid for labour, not gold; on exchange there is no fresh making charge on the old piece... many jewellers apply fresh making charges to the new piece.
Valuations will be based on the current market value of your jewellery (as per net weight of the metal and stone) and doesn't cover manufacturing charges and/or taxes.

Gold exchange offers from jewellers exis.correct: Gold exchange programmes are decades old in India — Titan/Tanishq's exchange scheme dates back roughly 25 years before 2026 (~2001), well before the May 2026 duty hike.

sources.quote: Titan, the country's largest jewellery retailer, was perhaps one of the first to come out with a gold exchange programme some 25 years ago.
